runbooks.name: rollout-prod
runbooks.note: Example runbook: roll a new ctx release out to a server that runs ghosttree under systemd.

spec.purpose: Roll ghosttree out on the production host: build, install the binary, take a cold copy of the database, switch the release link, start and check health

params.name: sha
params.description: Commit to roll out (at least 7 hex characters)

preconditions: The deploy key is loaded in the ssh agent: check its fingerprint with ssh-add -l, not its comment
The commit is merged and its CI checks passed

steps.title: Build the release binaries for {{sha}}
steps.check: The linux binary for the target architecture is in the output directory

steps.title: Copy the binary to the host
Install it into a new release directory
Take a cold copy of the database
Switch the release link and start
steps.command: sudo ln -sfn releases/{{sha}} /srv/ghosttree/current && sudo systemctl start ghosttree

rollback.title: Point the release link back to the previous release and restart
rollback.command: sudo ln -sfn releases/<previous> /srv/ghosttree/current && sudo systemctl restart ghosttree

targets.name: build
targets.comment: Build the release binaries for sha

runbooks.name: prod-ssh-zugang
runbooks.note: Example runbook: reach the production host without tripping its fail2ban.

spec.purpose: Connect to the production host with the right user and key
preconditions: Use the host alias from ~/.ssh/config, which sets user and key

steps.title: Check the key in the agent
steps.check: The deploy key's fingerprint is listed

steps.title: Connect through the alias
steps.check: The host name of the production server
